STL decomposition  
Employed = trend + season_year + remainder

*(Graph: STL decomposition showing four time-series panels over Month from 1990 Jan to 2020 Jan:)*

* **Employed** (values ranging from ~12500 to ~16500)
* **trend** (values ranging from ~12800 to ~16000)
* **season_year** (values ranging from −200 to 600)
* **remainder** (values ranging from −100 to 100)
